description: The agent keeps re-asking answered questions; the customer gets increasingly frustrated.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, this is Karan from Prithvi Health Insurance, this call is recorded. Is this a good time to talk?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, I filled the form for health insurance.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. Can I have your age please?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And which city do you live in?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sorry, could you tell me your age once again?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I already told you, forty two.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay. And which city are you in?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Bangalore! How many times do I have to repeat this? This is a waste of my time.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Do you have any existing medical conditions?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I said no. Just tell me the price, this is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. For ten lakh cover, after a thirty day waiting period, the premium is about eleven thousand rupees a year.
